entities.name: Albert II, Duke of Austria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Albert II, known as the Wise or the Lame, a member of the House of Habsburg, was duke of Austria and Styria from 1330, as well as duke of Carinthia and margrave of Carniola from 1335 until his death.
